title: Shadow Blade Ring
summary: Summon a 2d8 Psychic Shadow Blade once per Short Rest.

fields.Cast: Level 2, Bonus Action on yourself. Creates a Finesse, Light melee shortsword dealing 2d8 Psychic plus Strength or Dexterity. No Concentration. Lasts until Long Rest.
fields.Persistence: Patch 8 allows another blade each Short Rest. It can remain when the ring is removed, can be passed to another character, and can coexist with a blade made with spell slots.
fields.Acquisition: Arabella’s reward for Find Arabella’s Parents.
fields.Base value: 105 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay and acquisition details with pinned source evidence.
